sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Long-arm Centipede Giraffe (長手の百足 ジラフ, Long Arm Centipede Jirahu) is a mandatory Mini-Boss with two Deathblow Counters.
He's located inside the shrine in the Gun Fort of the Sunken Valley.
As the Sixth Prayer Necklace states, among Centipedes their leaders are called "long-arm" due to their claws.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Depending on which order some Bosses are fought, Vengeful Apparitions may appear inside the shrine, once this Mini-Boss is defeated.
